# Homework Assignment 2
Exploring patterns of environmental justice

## Import libraries and read data for analyses
```{r}
# Import libraries
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(stars)
```

```{r}
# Read in ejscreen data
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("EDS223-HW2", "data", "ejscreen", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# Read in HOLC Redlining data
holc <- sf::st_read(here::here("EDS223-HW2", "data", "mapping-inequality","mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))
```

```{r}
# Read in Bike and Pedesdtrian Crash data
crashes <- read_csv(here::here("EDS223-HW2", "data", "SWITRS_LA","Crashes.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Check if ejscreen and holc have same crs
st_crs(ejscreen) == st_crs(holc)

# Transform crs to match
holc <- st_transform(holc, crs = st_crs(ejscreen))

# Check crs
st_crs(ejscreen) == st_crs(holc)
```

## Part 1: Legacy of redlining in current environmental (in)justice

### 1.1 Mapping HOLC neighborhoods in LA County
```{r}
# Filter to Los Angeles County
la_county <- ejscreen |> 
    dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))
```

```{r}
tm_shape(holc) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill = 'grade',
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "HOLC Grade", position = tm_pos_out('right')),
        fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c("A" = "#76a865", "B" = "#7cb5bd", "C" = "#ffff00", "D" = "#d9838d"), value.na = "#ffffff"),
        lwd = 0.5
    ) +
tm_shape(la_county) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 0.5) +
    tm_title("Los Angeles County HOLC Neighborhoods")
```

### 1.2 Summarizing data

```{r}
# Join holc letter grades to ejscreen
ej_holc <- st_join(la_county, holc, join = st_intersects) |> 
    st_drop_geometry()
```


```{r}
summary <- ej_holc |> 
    group_by(grade) |> 
    summarize(n_blocks = n()) |> 
    mutate(pct_blocks = n_blocks/sum(n_blocks)*100)

print(summary)
```

### 1.3 Visualizing current conditions
```{r}
ej_by_holc <- ej_holc |> 
    group_by(grade)

# Calculate mean % low income by grade
pct_low_income <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(mean_pct_low_income = mean(LOWINCPCT)*100)

# Calculate mean percentile for PM 2.5
pctl_pm25 <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(mean_pctl_pm25 = mean(P_PM25))

# Calculate mean percentile low life expectancy
pctl_life_exp <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(mean_pctl_life_exp = mean(P_LIFEEXPPCT, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    data = pct_low_income,
    mapping = aes(x = grade, y = mean_pct_low_income)
    ) +
    geom_col() #fill = c("A" = "#76a865", "B" = "#7cb5bd", "C" = "#ffff00", "D" = "#d9838d"), value.na = "#ffffff")
```
